title: Magical Drop
overview:
A puzzle game of fairies!
Luck? Precision? Turn the tables in one shot with a massive chain!!

Magical Drop is a fast-paced action puzzle game. Rows of colored drops creep down from the top of the field while your character runs back and forth beneath them. Grab drops from the bottom of a column, then throw them up into another to line up three or more of the same color vertically and clear them. Gaps close as the drops above shift, setting off chain reactions that send extra rows crashing onto your opponent's side. Let the drops reach the bottom and you lose.

Watch for special drops that wipe out every drop of their color and ice drops that only break when something next to them clears.

- Single-player mode against every character and a final boss
- Two-player versus with selectable levels and match lengths
- Puzzle mode with 20 preset puzzles per character
- Endless mode with high scores saved to memory

妖精達のパズルゲーム!
偶然？ 緻密？ 大量連鎖で一発逆転!!
